I added a 0.25s sleep after each sandbox call in `tests/test_payments.py`, controlled by a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant. That caps the loop at about 4 requests per second, under the 5/s limit. I didn't run the tests, so I haven't confirmed the CI flake is gone.

The test makes only four calls, so the sleeps add about one second in total. If other tests also hit the sandbox, they'll need the same throttling. Parallel CI jobs would also share the limit.

I also saved the rate-limit fact to EngramDB as a hazard, so later sessions will see it.
